chunks.arabic_text: وَرَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Mālik ibn ʿAṭiyyah from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: فِي الرَّجُلِ يَتَزَوَّجُ الْمَرْأَةَ فَتَلِدُ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ تُرْضِعُ مِنْ لَبَنِهَا جَارِيَةً أَيَصْلُحُ لِوَلَدِهِ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَ تِلْكَ الْجَارِيَةَ الَّتِي أَرْضَعَتْهَا

translations.en: Regarding a man who marries a woman and she bears him a child, then she breastfeeds a bondwoman with her milk: is it permissible for his child from another woman to marry that bondwoman whom she breastfed?

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «لَا هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأُخْتِ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ لِأَنَّ اللَّبَنَ لِفَحْلٍ وَاحِدٍ».

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "No. She is in the position of a sister through breastfeeding, because the milk belongs to one male."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling in the laws of rada'ah (breastfeeding kinship). It states that a girl nursed by a woman becomes unmarriageable to the man's child from another wife, because the milk is attributed to the same father, establishing sibling-like kinship through breastfeeding.
en.seo_question: Can a man's child from another wife marry a girl breastfed by his wife?

key_terms.جَارِيَةً: a bondwoman or young female slave
key_terms.فَحْلٍ وَاحِدٍ: one male, meaning the same father to whom the milk is attributed
